metadata.description: Claude Code and Codex plugins for MongoDB Atlas Agent Engine.

plugins.name: aae
plugins.description: MongoDB Atlas Agent Engine toolkit: the aae-guide specialist (a subagent in Claude Code, a skill in Codex), the aae-scout prior-art and freshness check, skills that add an agent to an existing monorepo and tear one down cleanly, and an 'ae' shortcut for the agentengine CLI.

plugins.name: aae-docs-watch
plugins.description: Detects when MongoDB Atlas Agent Engine documentation pages change, by content hashing, and tells you once at session start, with per-page diffs. Built for a Public Preview product whose docs move weekly.
